requiredFutureAcceptance: Use one pinned custom PBX and one pinned Python-only carrier; two synthetic SIP identities share that client process, not a second PBX.
Network-free zero-exit Python preflight, private two-container network membership, zero published ports and existing isolation/resource checks remain mandatory.
Digest-challenge and register both identities using distinct ephemeral secrets; host verifies exactly the two expected dynamic contacts and configured endpoints/AORs.
Add only PJSIP/proof-agent to the initially empty proof queue and verify memberCount=1.
Authenticate the caller INVITE to queue-answer; caller ACKs its answer and agent returns 180 until the host observes one queued caller and ringing agent SIP leg.
Agent sends SDP 200, receives matching ACK; host requires two Up PJSIP legs sharing exactly the same live bridge ID.
Hold synthetic agent for four seconds after bridged host acknowledgement, then send correlated agent BYE and require 200.
Require sole caller in result hold with no queued callers, QUEUESTATUS=CONTINUE, 3500 <= ANSWEREDTIME_MS < 7000 and DIALEDTIME_MS >= ANSWEREDTIME_MS using the existing answered-result validator.
Caller sends BYE/receives 200; require zero channels, C:1/A:0, member took one call, dynamic member removal and exact empty queue-policy restoration.
Authenticate explicit unregistration of both identities and verify zero contacts while retaining two configured endpoints.
Preflight/client/PBX exit zero, unchanged warmed bridge/inventory, owned containers/network removed, both secret inputs and generated PBX credentials deleted.

offlineValidation.description: Unit/mocked protocol and orchestration checks only. No real sockets, Docker resources, registrations or calls were used for the answered mode.

limitations: This is offline preparation, not an executed answered SIP queue proof.
The minimal agent is intentionally not a general SIP stack; unexpected re-INVITE/CANCEL/dialogs fail explicitly.
No RTP payloads or quality assertions are part of answered mode; negotiated PCMU and bridged signalling do not establish media quality.
Four-second hold starts after host bridge acknowledgement. CLI/checkpoint overhead contributes to the measured answer interval and can legitimately fail the bounded validator.
Two synthetic identities on one isolated PBX do not prove multi-tenant isolation or real phone interoperability.
Earlier successful reports retain hashes for their executed revisions. Current source is a later offline revision; historical report hashes remain verified.
